subject: CVE-2023-3019
object: A DMA reentrancy issue leading to a use-after-free error was found in the e1000e NIC emulation code in QEMU. This issue could allow a privileged guest user to crash the QEMU process on the host, resulting in a denial of service.

subject: CVE-2024-21885
object: A flaw was found in X.Org server. In the XISendDeviceHierarchyEvent function, it is possible to exceed the allocated array length when certain new device IDs are added to the xXIHierarchyInfo struct. This can trigger a heap buffer overflow condition, which may lead to an application crash or remote code execution in SSH X11 forwarding environments.
object_canonical: a flaw was found in x.org server. in the xisenddevicehierarchyevent function, it is possible to exceed the allocated array length when certain new device ids are added to the xxihierarchyinfo struct. this can trigger a heap buffer overflow condition, which may lead to an application crash or remote code execution in ssh x11 forwarding environments.
